doc: Deprecation registry — policy §3/§8 (docs/upgrade-compatibility-policy.md), TASKLIST U4. Every deprecated construct (kind: api | event | migration | generic) records deprecated_in, removal_target, and a probe (path_glob + needle) the deprecation-clock gate (core-events/tests/deprecation_clock.rs, CI job 'deprecation-clock') uses to verify presence. Removals before removal_target fail CI, as does carrying anything past it. Event-kind entries must also be registered in core_events::contract::RETIRED_EVENTS (co-emit rule) — the conformance suite cross-checks both. Empty today: the first deprecation seeds the rules; the gate's self-tests prove every failure mode until then.
